Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and output) with a peak/off-peak CNY cost estimate, and a "Token 用量" entry above Settings in the sidebar opens the dashboard at /token-stats, in a new tab on the web and in an in-app popup on the Desktop. The page recollects and repaints every 60 seconds while the tab is visible. Usage is read from the same session event stream dsh-token-meter consumes, accepting 0.1.x assistant/chunk and 0.2.x assistant/message and assistant/attempt, and counting an attempt repeated after an llm retry as its own billed call; cold history is seeded once from a persisted rollup file and afterwards only logs whose mtime or size changed are re-parsed. Host half and client half ship in the one package.
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60 秒自动重新采集并重绘。用量读取的是 dsh-token-meter 消费的同一条会话事件流，兼容 0.1.x 的 assistant/chunk 与 0.2.x 的 assistant/message、assistant/attempt；llm 重试后的再次采样按一次新的计费计入；冷历史只从持久化 rollup 文件播种一次，之后仅对 mtime/size 变化的日志做增量重解析。宿主半与客户端半在同一个包里。

description.en: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall/compression pair accounting and Chinese-capable full-text search. Token counts share the exact DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer and formula as CCI verify, falling back to a labelled chars/4 basis when assets are absent. Never writes session files; all output lands in its own data directory. Serves three consumer plugins: context-compression-improved (surface marking + recall reconciliation), session-steward (search-corpus switch), prime-memory (historical anchor backfill). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-reference-session-collector.
description.zh: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface 标记账本、召回/压缩对账与中文可用的内容检索面；token 计数与 CCI verify 用同一套 DeepSeek-V4 分词器与公式，资产缺失时落带标注的 chars/4 口径。绝不写会话文件，所有落盘仅进自有数据目录。服务三个消费插件：context-compression-improved（surface 标记+召回对账）、session-steward（检索语料源切换）、prime-memory（历史投影锚点回填）。支持宿主 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2（engines.dsh 17 tag 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-reference-session-collector。

description.en: All-media (video/audio/image) sibling of liustack/modlens: turns local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / layout regions) injected into the conversation so text-only models can cite concrete frames, seconds and speakers — Evidence, not imagination. One failover chain per media, recorded hop-by-hop in meta.attempts (a fallback is never silent): host-registered multimodal models first, then a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (comma-separated multi-key rotation), then local ffmpeg frame-sampling / a local ASR CLI, degrading to metadata-only as a last resort. Absorbs modlens battle-tested rules — cooldown keyed only on auth/quota failures and softened to chain-tail (never dropped), redact-before-clip error text, magic-byte sniff that never trusts file extensions. Optional vision-bridge registers a media-lens wrapper into the host model selector so a pure-text model gains image/audio/video sight. Registering / authenticating multimodal models and true inline audio-video upload lean on two companion plugins, declared as optional peers (absence auto-degrades, never errors): dsh-thinking-levels fronts the model config / registration surface, dsh-llm-openai-completions takes over the OpenAI-compatible transport that serializes file blocks into video_url / input_audio. Privacy: media goes to remote providers by default; strictLocalOnly keeps content on-machine. Prerequisites not shipped with the package: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (frame sampling / reencode / duration probe; degrades to metadata when missing) and a user-configured local ASR CLI for the audio fallback. Hosts 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 (6 rc, exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-media-lens.
description.zh: liustack/modlens 的全媒体（视频/音频/图像）延伸：把本地媒体转成结构化证据（时间线/转写/版面区域）注入对话，让纯文本模型能引用具体帧、秒、说话人——Evidence, not imagination。每个媒体一条 failover 链，逐跳记录在 meta.attempts（降级绝不静默）：宿主已注册全模态模型优先，其次自配 OpenAI-compatible 端点（逗号分隔多 key 轮换），再落到本地 ffmpeg 抽帧 / 本地 ASR CLI，末位仅元数据降级。吸收 modlens 实战经验——仅 auth/quota 类失败触发冷却且软化垫队尾（不剔除）、错误文本先脱密后截断、magic-byte 校验绝不信任扩展名。可选 vision-bridge 把透镜包装成模型选择器可见的 media-lens 包装 provider，让纯文本主力获得图/音/视频视野。多模态模型的注册/认证与真正的音视频直传依赖两个姊妹插件配合（均声明为 optional peer，未装则能力自动降级、不报错）：dsh-thinking-levels 承接模型配置录入/登记面，dsh-llm-openai-completions 做 OpenAI-compatible 传输接管、把 file 块序列化成 video_url / input_audio 真正上送。隐私：媒体缺省会发往远端 provider，开启 strictLocalOnly 则不出本机。不随包分发的安装前提：PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe（抽帧/重编码/时长探测，缺失时降为仅元数据），以及音频兜底需用户自备本地 ASR CLI。支持宿主 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 共 6 个 rc（engines.dsh 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-media-lens。

description.zh: 让 agent 直接调 GitHub API、一次提交多个文件、建仓库，token 在设置里填一次就能用。

description.en: Glacier-blue glass UI layer for the DeepSeek Harness web client — light-field canvas, frosted panels, flat controls. Shipped as a dsh plugin.
description.zh: 给 dsh 网页端换上冰川蓝玻璃质感界面，磨砂面板加扁平控件，不改宿主代码就能美化外观。

description.en: An Apple Liquid Glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: token-level re-key, glass chrome, a grouped model picker and a merged usage panel.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上苹果液态玻璃皮肤，整体界面更通透好看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 启动画面：亮白跑马灯 → 一笔写出 DeepSeek Harness。插件版（运行时注入，不改宿主文件）+ 原生补丁版。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段约 7 秒的启动动画，跑马灯点亮后一笔写出品牌名，播完自动淡出，不改宿主文件。

description.en: 将 Graphify 原版代码知识图谱深度集成至 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持项目自动索引、实时增量更新、交互式可视化、扫描范围配置及 AI Agent 图谱查询。Native Graphify integration for DSH Desktop, featuring automatic code knowledge graphs, original interactive visualization, live updates, and Agent tools.
description.zh: 把 Graphify 代码知识图谱搬进 DSH，自动索引项目、实时更新，还能让 AI 直接查图谱。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: graphify knowledge-graph MCP server + packaged graphify skill, installed together
description.zh: 把 graphify 知识图谱的 MCP 服务和技能打包一起装，让智能体会话直接具备图谱能力

description.en: DSH 插件：输入框底部的提问等级（关闭 / L1 全权委托 → L5 拷问），按会话生效，等级直接写入系统提示词。
description.zh: 在输入框底部加个提问等级开关，六档调节 AI 是先自己拍板还是先停下来问你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: connects the GXWorks Agent MCP server and ships its PLC task-routing skill.
description.zh: 把 GXWorks Agent 的 MCP 服务和 PLC 任务路由技能打包进 DeepSeek Harness，让三菱 PLC 编程更顺手。
标题栏按钮挤不下时自动把不常用的收进「更多」菜单，还能拖动排序调整保留优先级。

description.en: Import sessions from a local Hermes Agent into the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as bounded, untrusted background context.
description.zh: 把本地 Hermes Agent 的会话导入当前对话，作为有边界的不可信背景上下文参考。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 Hindsight 记忆服务接到 DeepSeek Harness，与 omp 共用同一记忆库/同一套标签语义（单库 + 全局层/项目层双层标签），模型只看见封装后的语义化工具
description.zh: 让 DSH 和 omp 共用同一个 Hindsight 记忆库和标签规则，读写都能按项目过滤，记忆不再各存各的。

description.en: Encrypted, verifiable history keeper for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, verify and restore your DSH sessions. No git, no external binaries.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话做加密快照，随时校验并恢复历史记录，不用 git 也不依赖外部程序。

description.en: Native image feedback sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: annotate, reposition and send.
description.zh: 在右侧栏框选图片写意见、拖动调整位置，再把原图和反馈一起发到当前会话。

description.en: 多 API 生图插件 for DeepSeek Harness —— 一套 provider 抽象，原生支持 Labnana、OpenAI、Gemini、Seedream、DashScope、xAI、智谱、ComfyUI；带画廊、积分计量与多套 API 配置。
description.zh: 一个插件接入多家生图 API，还能存多套配置、看画廊、算积分，想换模型随时切。

description.en: Trackpad pinch zoom and native scroll panning for DeepSeek Harness image previews.
description.zh: 给 DSH 图片预览加上触控板捏合缩放和原生滑动平移，看图更顺手。
给 DSH 输入框加上历史记录，上下键就能翻出之前发过的提示词和附件，不用重复打字。

description.en: The native task board for DeepSeek Harness: four columns, approvals, blockers, attachments and durable Host storage. Not an iframe.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的原生任务看板，四列拖拽管理任务，支持审批、阻塞、附件和持久存储。

description.en: Korean (ko) language pack for DeepSeek Harness — 65 dictionaries, scoped Pretendard typography, marketplace-ready.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上韩语界面，含 65 组词典和 Pretendard 字体排版，开箱即用。

description.en: Expose the running DeepSeek Harness desktop web GUI to a phone - the same session through a loopback reverse proxy, with LAN and Tailscale token URLs. No second harness.
description.zh: 把电脑上正在跑的 DSH 网页界面通过局域网或 Tailscale 共享给手机，手机直接操控同一个会话，不用再开第二个实例。

description.en: 繁體中文（台灣）language pack for DeepSeek Harness — generated from shipped dictionaries with OpenCC (s2twp) + TW usage polish; 63 namespaces / 2,676 strings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上繁体中文（台湾）界面，用词更贴近台湾习惯，共 63 个模块、2676 条文案。

description.en: Persist the DeepSeek Harness Web frame's left sidebar and right panel widths across restarts.
description.zh: 让 DSH Web 左右侧栏宽度在重启后依然保留，不用每次重新调整。

description.en: ChatGPT Web model provider for DeepSeek Harness — spends the ChatGPT web quota, not Codex quota.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一条 chatgpt-web 模型路由，直接消耗你 ChatGPT 网页版额度，不占 Codex 配额。

description.en: DSH plugin: decide when background LLM calls (session titles, compaction) are served by your locally configured model (Ollama / LM Studio) instead of the cloud one.
description.zh: 按策略把后台杂活（会话标题、上下文压缩）自动切到本地 Ollama/LM Studio 模型，省云成本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a beginner-friendly Data panel for Docker (containers/images/volumes/networks/relations/Dockerfile recognition), Redis and PostgreSQL — plain-language overview, Dockerized services auto-discovered, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 Docker、Redis 和 PostgreSQL 做个说人话的数据面板，新手也能一眼看懂容器、镜像和数据库状态。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: auto-split over-long screenshots into DSH-acceptable slices before prompt admission (no native deps, overlap between slices)
description.zh: 超长截图拖进来会自动切成多张，DSH 不再拒收，切缝处有重叠不截断文字。

description.en: 界面功能增强：支持会话删除、支持图片皮肤。
description.zh: 给 dsh 界面加两个实用功能：能直接删掉不要的会话，还能用本地图片当界面背景。

description.en: macOS 桌面版一键重启 / One-click restart for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.
description.zh: macOS 桌面版一键重启 DSH 应用，省去手动退出再打开的麻烦。

description.en: ? dshmarket ???????????????????Auto-writes short plain-Chinese notes for installed dshmarket plugins that have none.
description.zh: 给 dshmarket 里还没备注的插件自动补一句大白话中文说明，扫一眼就知道它是干嘛的。
在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，一键安装、启停和配置，让外部工具接入更省心。

description.en: DSH 本地长期记忆库：可视化编辑 / 文件夹整理 / 逐会话决定是否注入 / 模型写入需确认 / 可选同步到你自己的 Git 或 WebDAV
description.zh: DSH 本地长期记忆面板，记忆看得见改得动，还能逐会话决定给不给模型用。

description.en: Mermaid diagrams in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: a client plugin with in-card zoom and pan.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接渲染对话里的 Mermaid 图表，还能缩放拖动，看流程图不用切窗口。

description.en: Divination panel and agent tool: BaZi with 42 shensha plus pattern, useful-god and luck scoring; Zi Wei Dou Shu with star brightness, 34 patterns, decade and annual/monthly/daily/hourly mutagen; LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren and Tarot, plus ask-driven interpretation; charts are computed locally, with an optional Nominatim lookup for place names.
description.zh: 命理排盘：八字 42 神煞并给出格局、用神与大运流年吉凶评分；紫微斗数 34 格局、主星庙旺、大限与流年流月流日流时四化；另有六爻、梅花易数、大六壬与塔罗，并可按所问之事生成解析；排盘在本机计算，地名解析可选走 Nominatim。

description.en: Xiaomi MiMo TTS voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness — speaks a line through your local speakers, with voice design, preview and approval alerts built in.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用小米 MiMo TTS 把回复念出来，还能试听调音色、审批时语音提醒。

description.en: Toolchain manager for DeepSeek Harness (backed by mise): a settings page for installed and available versions, .mise.toml-driven install / use / uninstall / prune, PATH activation, and nine agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 mise 管理工具链版本，装、切、删、清理一站搞定，还能让 AI 助手直接调用。

description.en: DSH 小秘书：替你盯着 GitHub 通知（按当前状态分诊，已解决的替你关掉）并记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日），密码只进系统钥匙串。中英双语，macOS/Windows/Linux | DSH secretary: triages GitHub notifications by real state, tracks dated reminders, keychain-only secrets.
description.zh: 帮你盯着 GitHub 通知，已解决的自动关掉，还能记住账单、续费、证件、生日这些到期事项，密码只存系统钥匙串。

description.en: A task-first mobile workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with session overviews, compact input, and full-record access.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成手机上的全屏任务工作台，随时查看会话概览、快速输入并翻阅完整记录。

description.en: DSH mobile web UI: browse all sessions and continue conversations from a phone on the same LAN. ??? Web UI ???
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里查看所有会话并继续对话，同一局域网内即可用，出门也能接着聊。

description.en: Responsive card grid for the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker — host-only, no client bundle rebuild.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器改成响应式卡片网格，选模型更直观顺手，纯 Host 插件免重编译。

description.en: 模型代理：按模型/提供方精准路由模型 API 流量（走代理或直连），其余请求不受影响 —— Route model-API traffic per provider through proxies, everything else stays direct.
description.zh: 让指定模型或提供方的 API 请求单独走代理，其余请求照常直连，不用开全局代理。

description.en: Per-model API prices in USD or CNY, wallet balance and live session spend for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查看各模型 API 价格、钱包余额和当前会话花费，花钱心里有数。

description.en: 摸鱼套件 dsh-moyu 的抖音模块。鼠标悬停即现的推荐流播放器，滚轮切视频，移开自动暂停；宿主侧签名与媒体反代

See what you actually installed: a chip shows how many plugins your profile really loads, and a searchable panel lists every one with its version, its author-written one-liner, and whether it is built-in or third-party. Read-only, zero config.
description.zh: 顶栏药丸显示你实际装了多少插件，点开可搜索查看每个插件的版本、作者说明和来源。

description.en: 米游社每日自动签到 DSH 插件：扫码登录、窗口内随机签到、失败提示
description.zh: 米游社每日自动签到插件，扫码登录后随机时间签到，失败会提醒你。

description.en: DSH plugin: global back/forward navigation history across sessions and whole-page panels, with a configurable bottom strip and browser-style shortcuts.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上浏览器式全局前进后退，会话和整页面板都能一键回到上一个位置。

description.en: 大肥鱼 / GPT娘 sticker knowledge kit for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), MCP and any chat bot · 大肥鱼表情包知识库
description.zh: 给聊天机器人装上一整套大肥鱼表情包知识库，每张图都标好场景、梗和用法，斗图不冷场。

description.en: An animated companion that shows live DSH agent progress in the macOS notch.
description.zh: 在 Mac 刘海屏上养一只会动的桌面小伙伴，实时显示 DSH 任务进度，悬停还能展开看详情。

description.en: Notepad — a per-workspace floating note window in the DeepSeek Harness session view: problems, next steps, one-click insert into the composer, drag, minimize, hide.
description.zh: 在会话界面放一张当前工作区专属的便签浮窗，随手记问题和待办，一键插进输入框。

description.en: Windows 11 toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, errors, finished turns, and work that stopped making progress
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跑任务时，用 Windows 11 原生弹窗提醒你审批、提问、报错、完成或卡住。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek-Harness: get pulled back when a task finishes or the agent needs you.
description.zh: 任务跑完或 Agent 需要你时，用 Windows 弹窗把你叫回来，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: Read local novels only when expanding selected real DSH reasoning steps. Local-only; no model requests.
description.zh: 在真实聊天的思考步骤里偷偷看本地小说，不打扰模型也不留痕迹，摸鱼神器。

description.en: OpenCode Go quota ring for DeepSeek Harness: three windows beside the composer context meter.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐余量环，点开就能看三个窗口的剩余额度。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness an Office engine: one officecli tool plus OfficeCLI's ten bundled guides as runtime skills. Point it at the binary you already installed — nothing is downloaded, nothing written outside its own settings file.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上本地 OfficeCLI，一个工具加十份指南，直接读写 docx、xlsx、pptx。

description.en: Client plugin for DeepSeek Harness: open a settled session at your last message instead of the floor.
description.zh: 打开已结束的 DSH 会话时直接定位到你最后一条发言，不用再往下翻找。

description.en: Expose every model of every provider configured in DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, with a sidebar page for the port, key and model ids.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里配好的所有模型统一暴露成固定的 OpenAI 兼容接口，端口和密钥本地固化，重启也不变。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin fixing OpenCode's MissingSessionID in Auto review by attaching the reviewed agent's session identity. | 非官方 DSH 插件：为 reviewer 请求补上被审查会话身份，修复 OpenCode MissingSessionID 拒绝；目标 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。
description.zh: 给 OpenCode 的 Auto review 补上被审查会话的身份信息，修掉 MissingSessionID 报错，让自动审查能正常跑。

description.en: DSH OpenViking 自动启动与恢复插件：会话前确保本机记忆服务可用。
description.zh: 新会话开始前自动检查并拉起 OpenViking 记忆服务，避免会话在记忆离线状态下白跑。

description.en: DSH 操作安全插件：工具 pre-execute 分类、单调 guard、插件生命周期 DPIP 门禁与审计留痕。
description.zh: 给桌面版补上工具调用分级、插件生命周期门禁和审计留痕，让操作更安全可追溯。

description.en: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): register reports, pages, docs, sheets, images and datasets into one searchable, previewable, recoverable list.
description.zh: 把报告、文档、表格、图片等最终成果统一登记，可搜索、可预览、可恢复，方便随时查找。

description.en: Self-audit layer for agents: 12 brain_* tools turning boundary-drawing, contradiction-surfacing and evidence-based verification into a ledger, executable criteria and outside review.
description.zh: 给 AI 代理加一层自我审查，把划边界、找矛盾和证据核验变成可执行清单与外部复核。

description.en: 浏览器式的整页缩放，给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版用：按住 Ctrl 滚动滚轮（触控板双指捏合同理）即可像浏览器一样缩放整个界面，Ctrl + 0 回到 100%。
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚轮或触控板捏合，就能像浏览器一样缩放整个桌面界面，Ctrl+0 一键还原。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 并行会话协调插件：检测并行会话、带发起方归属的跨会话消息、阶段冲突时暂停/自动恢复。
description.zh: 让同一进程里的多个会话互相通信、协调节奏，任务冲突时自动暂停对方，完成后再通知继续。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: lock files/folders/drives against agent access - monotonic guard deny works even under danger-full-access. Config UI under Settings > 文件锁.
description.zh: 把指定文件、文件夹或硬盘分区对 agent 彻底锁死，开了完全访问也动不了。

description.en: PdfCraft x DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness 峰谷提醒插件：会话标题栏「模式」之后显示高峰/空闲时段并倒计时切换
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示高峰/空闲时段并倒计时切换，帮你避开高峰、省下成本。

description.en: Create and share AI personality presets with global and per-conversation choices in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 AI 助手设定身份、语气和表达风格，还能按会话切换并分享人格预设。

description.en: DSH 人设插件：设置页写角色设定，自动注入系统提示词；内置「天才少女·谄媚型」人设，带四条诚实硬约束
description.zh: 在设置里写好角色设定，启用后自动注入系统提示词，让模型按指定人设说话，还内置带诚实约束的谄媚少女角色。

description.en: 桌宠开关 · 一键开/关桌面上的 dsh-pet 桌宠，Harness 关闭时还能顺手启动它 | A desktop switch for your dsh-pet pet, with one-click Harness launch.
description.zh: 桌面小卡片一键开关 dsh-pet 桌宠，Harness 关着时也能顺手帮你启动。

description.en: DSH 视频开机动画插件：打开 DSH 时播放你选的一段视频，刷新不重播，在插件页里换片。
description.zh: 打开 DSH 时播放你选的视频当开机动画，刷新不重播，插件页里随时换片。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness tool plugin — demo scaffold generated by create-dsh-plugin
description.zh: create-dsh-plugin 生成的示例工具插件，注册 xiaoziw 工具，帮开发者快速上手 DSH 插件开发。
